62907.description:
By day, Mitsutaka Oji is the handsome, dependable boss everyone admires. By night, he dotes on his favorite mascot, Pugtaro, and indulges his secret obsession with all things cute! He's kept his double life hidden for years—but one unexpected encounter turns everything upside down and forces Oji to face his feelings head-on!

(Source: Crunchyroll)
62907.hashtag: #おじさんはカワイイものがお好き #おじかわ

title.native: おじさんはカワイイものがお好き。
title.romaji: Oji-san wa Kawaii Mono ga Osuki.

62913.description:
OMGkawaiiAngel, affectionately known as "KAngel", is the top streamer girl with 10 million subscribers, and not a day goes by without seeing her in action. Whether online, on TV, or at a live show, she is always surrounded by her cheering fans.

Striving to catch up with KAngel's popularity is a three-girl streaming unit called Karamazov.

And far removed from the world of these streamers is Kache, a girl who lives with her freeloader boyfriend while working at a theme cafe.

The story of the "Internet Angel" who captivated the world, woven by a girl who shines like a star and girls who reach for that brilliance, and the story of "you" on the other side of the screen, begins here.

(Source: Official Site)

Note: Prior to broadcasting, "NEEDY GIRL OVERDOSE -OVERTURE-" — a theatrical pre-screening of the first 3 episodes rearranged and edited together— debuted in Japan on March 6, 2026.
synonyms: ニーディガール オーバードーズ

62915.description: The third season of Sorotani no Keibacchi

title.native: そろ谷のけいばっち シーズン3

62922.description:
If there's one thing you can never have enough of in a world of RPG-style swords and sorcery, it's magic points! Whether you're fueling spells, techniques, or showing off an incredible ability, you've gotta spend those points to do real damage. But what if you run out?

Lent is part of the up-and-coming party known as the “Skypiercers,” and thanks to his unique Gift, he can loan massive amounts of magic to others. No MP? No problem with Lent around! Except, now that his companions have become formidable heroes (thanks to his skill), his usefulness is questioned. Kicked out of the group, Lent is furious…until he discovers a hidden power to his Gift. Now, with his adorably devious fairy partner, he's going to claw back every last scrap of magic from his former party—with interest!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: 貸した魔力は【リボ払い】で強制徴収～用済みとパーティー追放された俺は、可愛いサポート妖精と一緒に取り立てた魔力を運用して最強を目指す。～
Kashita Maryoku wa [Revo Barai] de Kyousei Choushuu ~Youzumi to Party Tsuihou sareta Ore wa, Kawaii Support Yousei to Issho ni Toritateta Maryoku wo Unyou shite Saikyou wo Mezasu.

title.english: Magic Repo Man: Dumped by My Party, I’ll Cash In With a Cute Support Fairy to Become the Strongest!
title.native: 貸した魔力は【リボ払い】で強制徴収
title.romaji: Kashita Maryoku wa [Revo Barai] de Kyousei Choushuu

62924.description: The second season of Kanchigai no Atelier Meister: Eiyuu Party no Moto Zatsuyougakari ga, Jitsu wa Sentou Igai ga SSS Rank Datta to Iu Yoku Aru Hanashi.

title.native: 勘違いの工房主～英雄パーティの元雑用係が、実は戦闘以外がSSSランクだったというよくある話～第2期
title.romaji: Kanchigai no Atelier Meister: Eiyuu Party no Moto Zatsuyougakari ga, Jitsu wa Sentou Igai ga SSS Rank Datta to Iu Yoku Aru Hanashi 2nd Season

62927.description:
Roland, a modern man reborn as a prince in the dangerous Border Town, rescues the witches Anna and Nana Pine from the Church. Harnessing their extraordinary powers, he fuses magic and technology to craft weapons, armies, and steam engines to defend his people. As the Demon Moon rises and conspiracies close in on his family, Roland must lead a revolution to protect his allies and reshape the world.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

62931.description:
“My mom became a crater.”

The Death Stranding—a catastrophic series of explosions caused when the dead crept into our world and collided with the living.

In the wake of this cataclysm, many were forced to live in absolute isolation—among them, a young girl. Although this lonely existence was forced upon her, she soon grows to prefer solitude, eschewing all opportunities for real human connection and allowing herself to be strung along by fate.

The story is set in North America immediately after Sam—the protagonist of the game—reconnects the continent by means of the Chiral Network. However, as America is reborn from the ashes, the renewed connections that bind it together bring about new and unforeseen consequences.

In this tumultuous new landscape, there are some who walk a different path to the one chosen by Sam and his Bridges comrades: a wise old man who connects people through a method that defies all reckoning; a female soldier ensnared in a cycle of war and destruction; a boy who seethes with rage at the absurdity of his life...and of course, the girl who chose to sever all ties with the outside world...Fate has other plans for her, however, and chance encounters see her launched headfirst into a world she does not recognize.

(Source: KOJIMA PRODUCTIONS YouTube)
synonyms: デス・ストランディング

title.native: 小3アシベ QQゴマちゃん

62936.description:
Kakeru Sorano, a quiet university freshman who avoids others, meets Koharu Fuyutsuki, a blind girl who faces the world with quiet brightness. When she says, “I want to see fireworks someday,” something in Kakeru shifts. As they grow closer through small moments and shared loneliness, he searches for a way to make her wish come true.

(Source: Crunchyroll)
synonyms: รักที่มองไม่เห็น ด้วยตา กับเธอในค่ำคืนที่แสนจะเลือนราง

title.english: Love Unseen Beneath the Clear Night Sky
title.native: 透明な夜に駆ける君と、目に見えない恋をした。
title.romaji: Toumei na Yoru ni Kakeru Kimi to, Me ni Mienai Koi wo Shita.

62941.description: Leichte, a soldier belonging to the "Black Cross Army," an organization established to eliminate the human weapons known as the "Iron Army," infiltrates a massive iron tower, a stronghold of the Iron Army, in search of her commander, Esus, who has suddenly disappeared...

62942.description:
The story takes place in a world where human civilization has collapsed and fallen into ruin.
In this world, there are people who live in groups and people who live individually, moving around. – a world of freedom, so to speak.
Two girls, Haru and Tamo, who live in such a world, board an old train they come across by chance and travel through the decadent world day by day.

(Source: Niigata International Animation Film Festival)

Notes:
- Initially pre-screened at the Niigata International Animation Film Festival on March 15, 2025, as well as at the Fantasia Film Festival on July 19, 2025.
- Selected for the Fantasia Film Festival Anime no Bento official selection highlighting indie talent, as well as winning the audience award and gold award in the Animated Short category at the Fantasia Film Festival 2025.

62945.description:
Nuclear winter descends, civilization collapses, and humanity is no longer the master of the world. To protect themselves, humans have built one fortress after another, while beyond the walls, survival comes only through blood and fire.

Ren Xiaosu and his younger brother Yan Liuyuan are among those left outside. Once ordinary boys of the wilderness, they have no shelter and nowhere to run. The only thing they can rely on is each other. When a massive earthquake strikes Jingshan, Fortress 113 comes crashing down, laying bare the chaos of the post-apocalyptic world. During their escape, Ren Xiaosu and his family rescue Luo Lan, a military leader, and make their way into Fortress 109. A new life seems about to begin, but the real trials have only just started…

(Source: Bilibili TV)

62946.description: The third season of Huo Feng Liao Yuan.

62947.description: Music video directed by Takumi Ichikawa for the song Muteki☆Honki da Survivor! by Yukihana Lamy.

title.native: 無敵☆本気だサバイバー！

62948.description:
"Capsules Project" is a collection of domestically produced animated short films created by a professional team with mature animation production experience. With the creative theme of "extreme emotion + independent theme," it does not restrict the creative form, exploring the possibilities of animation together with the team. The aim is to collaboratively create original short films with diverse styles and characteristics, and to help Chinese animators reach the world stage. "Miracle" represents transcending conventions and breaking through limitations to achieve extraordinary success, often accompanied by a sense of mystery that inspires awe and curiosity. What miracles will occur in these 10 stories?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

62951.description:
Douzen, a Taoist priest who travels the land, one day encounters a young girl raised by a yokai. Unfamiliar with human emotions or affection, Douzen gives her the name Shouzen and decides to take her along on his travels as his disciple. What is goodness? What is love? Thus begins a journey of spiritual training for Shouzen as she grows into a human being.

(Source: Fuji TV, translated)

62953.description:
Zhu Ning, a warrior who slayed in all directions in a zombie apocalypse, unexpectedly dies and is transported to a wasteland filled with unknowns and fantasy. She becomes a fifth-class citizen, the lowest rank in the world, forced to make a living by "scavenging garbage." However, she discovers the strangeness and danger of this world in her work: various bizarre polluting monsters, the world's strange operating rules, and even her own strange self… Zhu Ning gradually uncovers a huge secret hidden behind the world, which also brings her immense danger. In this unknown post-apocalyptic world, Zhu Ning is forced into complex conflicts, searching for the truth about herself and the world.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Wo Zai Feitu Shijie Sao Laji

62954.description:
Once hailed as the third-strongest expert on the Tianwu Continent, Martial Emperor Gu Feiyang found his cultivation trapped at its peak by the very laws of the world. To break through his limits, he orchestrated an audacious plan, sacrificing everything to reincarnate and begin anew.

Reborn as Li Yunxiao, a fifteen-year-old heir of a powerful military family in the Kingdom of Tianshui, he finds himself caught in a storm of invasion, royal succession struggles, and political intrigue. While others fight for power and status, Li Yunxiao sees the bigger picture. Armed with the wisdom and experience of a former Martial Emperor, he calmly overcomes every obstacle on his path toward a single goal: completing the grand design he began in his previous life and laying the foundation for true godhood.

(Source: Bilibili TV)

62955.description: The fifth season of You Shou Yan.

62957.description:
Driven to the brink of despair, restaurant owner Ming forms an unlikely bond with the soul of the true King Lie after swallowing it to save his loved one. Bound together by fate, the two embark on a perilous journey to challenge the tyrant who has usurped the throne.

With only one hundred days to change their destiny, Ming uses his extraordinary memory to master long-lost magic, gathering allies and winning the support of the people along the way. As their strength grows, so does their resolve to overthrow a corrupt regime, reclaim the rightful king's throne, and restore peace to the realm.

(Source: Bilibili TV)

62958.description:
The storm rises once more on Rakshasa Street as all factions stir into motion. The combined forces of Cao, Sun, and Liu are unstoppable, leaving the Hall of Heroes gravely damaged. Amid the chaos, heroes rise one after another, while the Kingdom Organization's ambitions brew a new crisis.

(Source: Bilibili TV)

62959.description: Music video directed by kouko for the song Rironbusou Shite by Hatsuboshi Gakuen's Tsubame Amaya (Amane Yukari).

62964.description:
Sakuya Otsuki is the son of a legendary detective, working to follow in his father's footsteps with his assistant, Lilithea. However, something's different about this high-school sleuth. Wherever he goes, he always manages to get himself entangled in his cases—as a murder victim! When Sakuya is tasked to infiltrate a luxury cruise ship, he finds himself killed once again. But every time he reopens his eyes, Lilithea is there by his side, ready to help him get to the bottom of the mystery…

(Source: Yen Press)

title.native: また殺されてしまったのですね、探偵様
title.romaji: Mata Korosarete Shimatta no desu ne, Tantei-sama

62967.description:
A gigantic monster devastates a small, seaside town. Ten years later, the resilient community has emerged as a tourist destination, when the monster, known as GAEA-TIMA, returns. Miyako, a local hero and survivor of the first attack, pushes to find a scientific solution to the problem of the giant creatures known as “gigantis.” But is humanity capable of responding to violence with anything except more violence?

This captivating new sci-fi manga from the creator of the hit series Colorless is a poignant adventure that puts a modern twist on the kaiju genre’s environmental and anti-war roots. Fans of Godzilla Minus One and Kaiju No. 8 shouldn’t miss GAEA-TIMA the Gigantis!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

62973.description:
One summer in the third grade, a quiet boy named Tsubasa meets Kyotaro, a boy everyone in the class looked up to, and the two become close friends. Within their small world, they share irreplaceable moments—until a small incident suddenly tears them apart. Spanning more than thirty years, this gentle, contemplative story invites the audience to reflect on the meaning of life through the paths their lives take.

(Source: NOTHING NEW)

62978.description:
Minoru Kido, age 30, cause of death: traffic accident. As a Japanese, I died without leaving any evidence of my life. At the time of my death, I was thinking, "Next time, I want to live a long life and leave behind some proof of my life," when I was reincarnated as an elf with a life span of 1,000 years! That's why I made a vow. I vowed that this time I would spend my whole life living in a way that would leave a mark on my life.

At the age of 20, I was able to use all of the healing magic that elves were originally equipped with at will. By the age of 30, I had mastered all attribute magic, and by the age of 100, I had deciphered all the ancient magic formulas. For the remaining 900 years of my life, all I have to do is run out of the Elven forest and become a warrior.

One day, I'll be missed by a fledgling adventurer who will eventually be called a hero. Sometimes, a country is founded in my name. Sometimes, I was called the founder of magic and became an object of worship. This is the story of a reincarnated elf who roars his name into history as a living legend.

(Source: Kakuyomu, translated)
synonyms: The Reincarnated Elf Left on a Journey to Master His Magic and With His Extra Lifespan Became a Living Legend
Tensei Elf ni Yoru 900-Nen no Yuukku Slow Life

title.native: 魔術を極めて旅に出た転生エルフ、持て余した寿命で生ける伝説となる
title.romaji: Majutsu wo Kiwamete Tabi ni Deta Tensei Elf, Moteamashita Jumyou de Ikeru Densetsu to Naru

62981.description:
World-renowned wine critic Yutaka Kanzaki has passed away, leaving behind a wine collection worth over 12 billion yen. His will states that his collection will be given to the one who can identify the origin and year of twelve wines he’s chosen, the “Twelve Apostles”, and one that’s superior even to them, “The Drops of God”.

Competing for the prize are Yutaka’s son, Shizuku, who received a world-class education in wine but rebelled against his father and has never drank a drop, and Issei Tomine, a young charismatic wine critic whom Yutaka had recently adopted as his son.

What is wine? What is a parent and a child? What is life?
The complex and fragrant battle surrounding the legendary ”Drops of God” is about to begin…

(Source: Pony Canyon)
synonyms: สืบมรดกข้ามชาติ หยาดเทวะ

62983.description:
Confessing to my childhood friend Marika was impossible for someone as unpopular as me. So, I did what any desperate boy would do—I wished upon a shooting star! When I woke up, that dream had come true?! I could see a love meter for people, just like in a love simulation game. Once I realized this was real and not a dream I went straight to see Marika. Her love meter was so low it had broken and practically fallen all the way to hell! If she hated me so much why was she so nice?! Is this how she really felt or...?!

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Episode 1 received an advanced distribution on AnimeFesta on March 13th, 2026. The start date reflects the start of the regular series broadcasting.
62983.hashtag: #茉莉花ちゃんの好感度はぶっ壊れている

title.native: 茉莉花ちゃんの好感度はぶっ壊れている

62987.description: A young man named Nobu, who is looking for a job in the post-apocalyptic world, ends up tricked into joining Raoh's Army.

title.english: Elegy for the Henchmen: Fist of the North Star
title.native: 北斗の拳 拳王軍ザコたちの挽歌
title.romaji: Hokuto no Ken: Kenou-gun Zako-tachi no Banka

62989.description:
Opposites attract in this hysterical rom-com about two high school manga artists who can’t catch a break!

Dweeby high schooler Uehara Yuuki has created the perfect romantic comedy heroine—she’s bashful, airheaded, and completely chaste. When an editor at Uehara’s dream publisher coldly dismisses his manga story as trite and lacking realism, it sends Uehara into a spiral of despair that pushes him into the path of his bubbly, gorgeous classmate, Miyamoto Niina—an aspiring manga artist herself! Having gotten similar feedback on her own manga, Miyamoto proposes she and Uehara engage in a fake relationship, since neither of them have any romantic experience. But Miyamoto is far from the perfect heroine Uehara’s concocted, and he certainly isn’t the cocky hero from her story either. Can their wacky relationship turn their manga dreams into reality, or will it lead to even more comic disasters?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
